rules: Every episode has a complete source range, including episodes without name matches.
Authored sections are a first-pass navigation map, not independent exhaustive atomic certification.
Shared-scene context is not pair-specific action evidence.
Memory, report, hypothesis, comparison and remote communication are separate from current in-person meetings.
No source prose is rewritten or duplicated in this dataset.

sections.title: Schedule call while the twins are away
sections.reading: Dhika notices their absence and calls. They explain their return timing and ask about the next tuition session.

sections.title: Absence reference
sections.reading: This later reference is not an in-person twin encounter.

sections.title: Preparing for tuition
sections.reading: Dhika privately prepares for the twins. Preparation does not establish that they are present yet.

sections.title: Tuition and academic result
sections.reading: Both arrive for study. Academic performance and an offer of help precede the later interaction.

sections.title: Assistance and separate responses
sections.reading: The shared visit moves from practical assistance to requests and reactions. Actor-specific tags from the existing ledger remain separate.

sections.title: Requests and boundaries
sections.reading: The dialogue contains separate requests and boundary responses; acceptance of one step is not general permission.

sections.title: Unfinished shared visit
sections.reading: The visit remains open at the episode boundary. E13 resumes the same visit rather than starting another one.

sections.title: Conclusion of the E12 visit
sections.reading: This is the ending of the visit begun in E12, including separate responses and departure.

sections.title: Private aftermath
sections.reading: Dhika reflects after the twins leave. The later visitor is a different person.

sections.title: Recall during another visit
sections.reading: A reference to the twins occurs within another-character scene; it is not renewed attendance.

sections.title: A second callback
sections.reading: Keep this memory separate from the earlier completed visit.

sections.title: Bobby used as a personality comparison
sections.reading: Dhika compares quiet personalities while speaking with Raj. Bobby is not thereby present.

sections.title: Contrasting communication styles
sections.reading: The narration contrasts Raj with Bobby and Bantu. It is a comparison, not a twin meeting.

sections.title: A remembered reaction
sections.reading: Dhika recalls earlier reactions while speaking with John; the old event is not counted again.

sections.title: Mock-test preparation
sections.reading: Dhika looks forward to tuition, prepares a mock test and waits for the twins.

sections.title: Arrival and possible Switzerland trip
sections.reading: Both arrive. They discuss the competition and ask Dhika to accompany them if they win. She agrees only to consider it.

sections.title: Reward discussion and initial refusals
sections.reading: A study reward develops into repeated requests. The initial refusals and individual replies remain part of the sequence.

sections.title: Changed clothing and Bantu-specific contact
sections.reading: The group scene includes a clothing change and an individually attributed Bantu interaction. Group presence does not give Bobby the same action.

sections.title: Bobby-specific reassurance
sections.reading: Dhika responds to Bobby feeling overlooked and offers reassurance. Bantu is present in the wider scene.

sections.title: Return to the mock test
sections.reading: Dhika returns to teaching, changes course when attention drifts, then goes to the kitchen after the test.

sections.title: Kitchen interval with Bantu
sections.reading: Bantu follows Dhika into the kitchen. Their private exchange is distinct from the tuition group.

sections.title: Bobby returns; group farewell begins
sections.reading: Bobby enters, they return to the hall, and the reward conversation resumes. The scene continues in E18.

sections.title: Bobby action and Bantu request
sections.reading: The E17 visit continues. Bobby initiates an action; Bantu makes a different request and receives a separate response.

sections.title: Teasing, clothing decisions and reactions
sections.reading: The twins and Dhika make separate choices. Observations and reactions are not interchangeable with physical actions.

sections.title: Final interaction and departure
sections.reading: Bobby initiates another interaction before Dhika ends the visit. Her farewell to each twin precedes a private reflection.

sections.title: Discussing the competition with John
sections.reading: The twins are away at the competition. John supports the possibility of travel; his knowledge remains limited to what Dhika tells him.

sections.title: Late-night result video call
sections.reading: The twins announce their win by video call. John joins to congratulate them; the later couple conversation is aftermath.

sections.title: Dinner invitation and announced gift
sections.reading: A later call covers the competition, a dinner invitation and an incoming gift. John accepts the invitation separately.

sections.title: Gift arrives before dinner
sections.reading: The gift is delivered and discussed with John. The twins are absent until the restaurant arrival.

sections.title: Restaurant arrival
sections.reading: Dhika and John meet the waiting twins. Dinner continues in E19.

sections.title: Dinner and travel agreement
sections.reading: The restaurant meeting from E18 continues. Dhika agrees to accompany the twins after the discussion; they leave in separate cars.

sections.title: Couple conversation after dinner
sections.reading: John and Dhika discuss the twins and the proposed trip after leaving them.

sections.title: Messages become a video call
sections.reading: Bantu initiates messages, asks for a call, and Dhika moves to another room before calling.

sections.title: Camera framing and repeated requests
sections.reading: The twins participate remotely. Camera framing, visible clothing and each request/response need their own evidence.

sections.title: Trust, teasing and a proposed travel rule
sections.reading: The conversation shifts from compliments to a challenge and travel clothing expectations.

sections.title: Dhika states conditions
sections.reading: Dhika adds explicit conditions about her own clothing and comfort. Later choices in this call do not erase those conditions.

sections.title: Airport and shared flight
sections.reading: The trio travels together, chooses adjacent seats and spends the flight talking and resting.

sections.title: Geneva arrival and room arrangements
sections.reading: Stacy welcomes them, explains the programme and takes them to their accommodation. Dhika chooses the sofa rather than the twins’ bed.

sections.title: Lunch, film and the first outfit
sections.reading: An ordinary afternoon moves through food, a film and discussion of a gifted outfit.

sections.title: Shopping and changing-room privacy
sections.reading: They shop together. A separate Bantu exchange occurs around the changing room; it is not an equivalent Bobby action.

sections.title: Rain and practical warming
sections.reading: Rain sends them back to their accommodation. Practical help to warm up leads into the shared scene continued in E21.

sections.title: Warming scene continues
sections.reading: The E20 rain scene resumes. Practical assistance and the subsequent choices are different phases of the same setting.

sections.title: Bantu-specific exchange in the shared setting
sections.reading: Bantu and Dhika have an individually attributable exchange while Bobby is in the wider setting.

sections.title: Bobby re-enters the interaction
sections.reading: Dhika acknowledges Bobby separately. The twins then leave to dress; their roles must not be merged.

sections.title: Doorway interruption and dressing
sections.reading: A doorway interaction and different sightlines occur before Dhika dresses. What each twin sees requires separate attribution.

sections.title: Private Bantu interval and a stop response
sections.reading: Bobby leaves for water. During the private interval Dhika reports pain, Bantu apologizes, and the interaction changes before Bobby returns.

sections.title: Separate sleeping places and early cold
sections.reading: They initially settle separately. Dhika’s move towards the bed at the end leads into E22’s account.

sections.title: Morning position and the 4 AM explanation
sections.reading: The morning account includes a retrospective explanation of why Dhika joined Bobby under a comforter. Do not count the flashback as a second night.

sections.title: Reassuring Bantu
sections.reading: Dhika responds to Bantu feeling excluded, promises a different sleeping arrangement and gives a separate affectionate response.

sections.title: Breakfast and a partial disclosure to John
sections.reading: Breakfast preparation precedes a private call. Dhika reports only part of the prior shared scene to John.

sections.title: Morning conversation and sofa interaction
sections.reading: Dhika and Bantu have a private interval while Bobby is bathing. The bathroom door interrupts it.

sections.title: Narrated agreement between the twins
sections.reading: The narrator supplies an earlier conversation between the twins. This does not establish that Dhika knows the agreement.

sections.title: Gifted outfit and kitchen interval
sections.reading: Bantu offers a dress and follows Dhika as she changes. Requests, privacy instructions, actions and reactions are separate.

sections.title: Programme visit and return to the hotel
sections.reading: The trio attends the programme, returns in the rain and discusses the evening. Bobby’s offer of another outfit continues in E23.

sections.title: New outfit and changing-room choice
sections.reading: The E22 offer resumes. Dhika first changes in their view, then leaves for privacy. Bantu goes to reception.

sections.title: Private Bobby interval; Bantu returns
sections.reading: Bobby and Dhika interact while Bantu is away. Bantu returns near the end as an observer, not as the actor in the earlier interval.

sections.title: Network failure, nap and dinner
sections.reading: The trio finds the network unavailable, contacts reception, rests and prepares dinner.

sections.title: Conversation about earlier conduct
sections.reading: Bantu raises the earlier interaction; Dhika answers and privately reflects. The conversation is not a repetition of those actions.

sections.title: Dinner conversation and an altered shirt
sections.reading: A second gift and a practical clothing problem lead to Dhika’s own adjustment. The twins return from the balcony afterwards.

sections.title: Shared interaction with distinct roles
sections.reading: This is a shared scene with different actions for the twins and Dhika. L4229 contains a conflicting actor name relative to nearby action continuity; it is retained as an ambiguity, not silently reassigned.

sections.title: Aftermath and private reflection
sections.reading: The E23 scene ends with the twins resting. Dhika withdraws and considers her relationship with John.

sections.title: Morning concern and separate apologies
sections.reading: The twins notice her mood. Bobby’s concern and Dhika’s explanation are distinct from her private uncertainty.

sections.title: Email disclosure and reply
sections.reading: The exchange with John describes and discusses prior events. A report is not another encounter with the twins.

sections.title: Reconsidering the prior night
sections.reading: Dhika reflects on John’s words and the earlier shared scene; what she remembers differs from what she has disclosed.

sections.title: Return to everyday company
sections.reading: The scene returns to shared food/film and conversation, then resting. Individual Bantu and Bobby actions remain separately attributable.

sections.title: Dream before waking
sections.reading: The opening is explicitly a dream, terminated by waking at L4422. Do not count its actions as a completed twin encounter.

sections.title: Waking and a private Bobby interval
sections.reading: Dhika wakes with Bobby nearby. Their private exchange is distinct from the opening dream and later shared morning.

sections.title: Programme arrangements and breakfast
sections.reading: Dhika speaks with Stacy and the twins wake, have breakfast and prepare for the day.

sections.title: Bathroom invitations and stated limits
sections.reading: Separate invitations, a shared setting and explicit limits occur before they dress. Limits are not erased by later participation.

sections.title: Programme day and Kate
sections.reading: They attend the programme together. Attention to Kate is context, not an interaction by Kate in the selected pair.

sections.title: Bantu asked to shower
sections.reading: Dhika makes a separate affectionate response before Bantu goes to shower.

sections.title: Bobby reassured while Bantu is away
sections.reading: Bobby expresses feeling overlooked. Dhika reassures him and their private interaction is not knowledge shared automatically with Bantu.

sections.title: Dinner and bedtime clothing discussion
sections.reading: Food and household activity precede discussion of another outfit and further requests.

sections.title: Shared bedtime interaction
sections.reading: Different actions occur together in a shared sequence. The aftermath continues in E26.

sections.title: Aftermath and overnight arrangements
sections.reading: The E25 scene leads into washing, rest and the overnight arrangement. Later sleep positions are not newly initiated encounters.

sections.title: Tonight buddy insert
sections.reading: This short insert is a preview, not evidence of a completed current action. Its text later appears in the final-evening scene.

sections.title: Early-morning Bantu interval
sections.reading: Dhika’s choice of outfit precedes a private exchange with Bantu, followed by her withdrawal to shower.

sections.title: Bobby’s outfit gift
sections.reading: Dhika returns after washing. Bobby offers another outfit and they discuss it.

sections.title: Private kitchen interval with Bobby
sections.reading: Bobby follows Dhika into the kitchen. Their interaction ends before Bantu’s next interval.

sections.title: Bantu follows; Bobby later interrupts
sections.reading: Bantu notices Bobby leaving and then approaches Dhika. Bobby’s return marks another transition.

sections.title: Getting ready to go out
sections.reading: Both twins see Dhika’s chosen dress. The outing continues in E27.

sections.title: Outing, a refused drink and return
sections.reading: The outing includes a request Dhika refuses. They return and discuss how to spend the evening.

sections.title: Shared film and increasingly personal interaction
sections.reading: The shared evening includes individual requests, gestures and responses. Being in the room is not the same as performing each action.

sections.title: Further choices and an explicit boundary
sections.reading: The shared sequence includes a request and a stated limit. Its outcome must be traced separately for each actor.

sections.title: Overnight position and Dhika’s interpretation
sections.reading: This is overnight aftermath with an explanation partly presented as Dhika’s own thought. It is not an independent narrator-certified reconstruction.

sections.title: Airport, family calls and return flight
sections.reading: They speak with their families, travel home and part at the airport. The Switzerland stay ends here.

sections.title: Private recall after returning
sections.reading: Dhika recalls the trip after parting from the twins.

sections.title: Recall involving Bantu
sections.reading: The current scene is with another character. Bantu is remembered rather than present.

sections.title: Overlapping remembered experiences
sections.reading: The narration recalls prior experiences with different people. Their distinct events are not merged into a group meeting.

sections.title: Identifying a mark from the trip
sections.reading: Dhika answers John about a mark associated with Bobby. This is a disclosure about an earlier event.

sections.title: John asks about the trip
sections.reading: John’s curiosity and questions are part of the couple scene, not a new meeting with either twin.

sections.title: Bobby hears an unintended call
sections.reading: Bobby hears audio and draws his own conclusions. Bantu later enters and hears only part of the situation; their knowledge differs.

sections.title: Teaching assignment changes
sections.reading: The twins are absent from Dhika’s immediate day. A teacher swap changes classroom contact; tuition remains a separate arrangement.

sections.title: Earlier gift worn again
sections.reading: A reference to clothing from the trip is not a new twin gift or encounter.

sections.title: Bantu used as a comparison for Leo
sections.reading: The narrator compares physiques. Bantu is not present in the current scene.

sections.title: Could a twin be the Stranger?
sections.reading: John and Dhika speculate about the sender. This is an unresolved hypothesis, not confirmation of identity.

sections.title: Comparing familiar people
sections.reading: Dhika compares Leo, John and Bantu. Keep comparison separate from current attendance.

sections.title: Video call and a family meeting arranged
sections.reading: Bobby starts a video call, Bantu joins and they arrange their mother’s visit. Camera observations differ between the twins; Dhika ends the call.

sections.title: Meeting with the twins and their mother
sections.reading: The text reports the family meeting after it has ended. Do not invent its unshown dialogue.

sections.title: Guessing who sent the parcel
sections.reading: Dhika suspects a twin, especially Bantu. The sender is not established by her suspicion.

sections.title: Preparing for an overnight stay
sections.reading: Dhika plans household shopping because the twins will stay. This is preparation rather than arrival.

sections.title: Evening arrival begins
sections.reading: The twins arrive at the end of E35; their greeting continues into E36.

sections.title: Welcome and settling in
sections.reading: Dhika welcomes both twins, asks about dinner and arranges snacks and a film.

sections.title: The twins deny sending the Stranger gifts
sections.reading: Both deny sending the parcels. Earlier guesses must not remain confirmed sender facts.

sections.title: Film, biscuits and a proposed game
sections.reading: An ordinary snack/film scene develops into a game. Individual turns and requests must remain separate.

sections.title: Different game turns and reassurance
sections.reading: Bobby and Bantu take different turns. Dhika responds to feeling and participation separately for each twin.

sections.title: Bantu-specific action at the episode boundary
sections.reading: A Bantu-specific action ends the episode. Its boundary response occurs in E37, so E36 alone does not establish the eventual outcome.

sections.title: Chicken-game preview
sections.reading: The opening game lines anticipate E38. Do not place the game before the resumed clasp scene.

sections.title: Boundary response and a limited promise
sections.reading: The repeated clasp line resumes E36. Dhika tells Bantu to refasten it, and he does; a later promise is explicitly limited to under a top.

sections.title: The twins away for tuition
sections.reading: A call with John and later context establish that the twins are elsewhere. The intervening visitor is not one of them.

sections.title: Uncertain identity at the door
sections.reading: Dhika wonders who is present. This question alone does not establish an arrival.

sections.title: Twins return in the rain
sections.reading: The twins return late, dry off and change while Dhika helps practically.

sections.title: Returning to the earlier clothing promise
sections.reading: The group discusses the earlier limited promise. This scene continues in E38.

sections.title: TV gives way to a game
sections.reading: The E37 visit continues. A game is proposed and explained; its stated rules are not blanket permission for unrelated conduct.

sections.title: Bantu’s game turn
sections.reading: Bantu takes the first turn, with requests and responses linked to that turn.

sections.title: Bobby’s game turn
sections.reading: Bobby asks for a turn. The different direction and consequences of his turn are not assigned to Bantu.

sections.title: Shared choices and unequal sightlines
sections.reading: The shared sequence includes conditions and different observations. Dhika’s belief about who saw what must be distinguished from narrator information.

sections.title: Aftermath and unshared knowledge
sections.reading: The E38 scene concludes. Dhika does not know everything Bantu observed; later sleeping positions belong to aftermath.

sections.title: Late-night Bobby conversation
sections.reading: After returning from the neighbour, Dhika meets an awake Bobby. Bantu is asleep rather than participating.

sections.title: Bobby’s private game begins
sections.reading: The pair begins another game. This is a different episode of interaction from the earlier shared group game and continues in E40.

sections.title: Private game concludes
sections.reading: The E39 Bobby interaction continues, followed by a request to keep it private. No equal knowledge is assigned to Bantu.

sections.title: Twins out; John asks a question
sections.reading: The twins are visiting friends while Dhika speaks with John. The call concerns previous events.

sections.title: Video call and swimming invitation
sections.reading: A call invites Dhika to a friend’s empty house. Bobby and Bantu have different camera sightlines; Bantu says he missed the incident.

sections.title: Choosing swimwear and recalling earlier scenes
sections.reading: These are preparation and memory, not arrival at the pool.

sections.title: Photo in the shared chat
sections.reading: Dhika posts a photo and receives different responses. Chat is a remote interaction, not physical co-presence.

sections.title: Pickup and arrival at the pool
sections.reading: Bantu collects Dhika and the scene moves to the swimming venue. Swimwear selection precedes the shared pool interaction.

sections.title: Swimming and distinct pair interactions
sections.reading: The pool sequence has different interactions with each twin. Practical support, requests and later actions need actor-specific evidence.

sections.title: Conditions and different observations
sections.reading: The shared scene sets an observation condition, but the later narrator account distinguishes what Bobby actually sees from Dhika’s expectation.

sections.title: Pool aftermath and private recollection
sections.reading: The narration refers back to the pool and later departure. Recollection is not a second pool meeting.

sections.title: Partial disclosure to John
sections.reading: Dhika answers John about Bobby. The report is limited to what she actually says.

sections.title: Asking John about his reaction
sections.reading: The couple discusses the previously disclosed Bobby event. This is not current twin attendance.

sections.title: Comparing an outfit with the earlier trip
sections.reading: The current scene is with Sharmi; the twins appear only as a comparison to prior clothing.

sections.title: Brief interrupted video call
sections.reading: The twins see a brief camera incident before the connection cuts. The same moment is repeated at the start of E45.

sections.title: Repeated opening and follow-up call
sections.reading: The opening repeats E44’s interrupted moment. Dhika’s follow-up, the twins’ replies and John’s limited knowledge are separate; the repeated text is not a second incident.

sections.title: Worrying about a future meeting
sections.reading: Dhika thinks about the prior twin scene and how she will face them. No new meeting is established here.

sections.title: A hypothetical Bantu comparison
sections.reading: Dhika imagines how Bantu might behave. This is not an action that occurred.

sections.title: John posts a photo to the twins’ group
sections.reading: The sending and Dhika’s reaction are shown; a response from the twins is not shown in this passage.

sections.title: Private reflection on earlier changes
sections.reading: These lines refer to prior experiences and clothing habits. They do not establish a visit.

sections.title: John proposes another photo share
sections.reading: A proposed send is not treated as a completed send without later evidence.

sections.title: Bobby arrives while Bantu gives John a lift
sections.reading: Bobby visits Dhika; he explains where Bantu is. Bantu is not present during this opening.

sections.title: Private Bobby exchange
sections.reading: A Bobby-specific interaction begins and continues across the E50–E51 boundary.

sections.title: Bobby interval interrupted by the doorbell
sections.reading: The E50 scene resumes. Dhika sends Bobby to answer the door; the interruption is part of the same private interval.

sections.title: Bantu arrives with a gift and an invitation
sections.reading: Bantu returns, presents a gift and invites Dhika to try their games console. She agrees to visit after college.

sections.title: Discussing an earlier shared photo
sections.reading: They ask about the photo sent earlier. A reference to the image is not another photo-sharing event.

sections.title: After the twins leave
sections.reading: Dhika privately wonders what Bobby inferred. Their departure is not a remote call.

sections.title: Video-call request and Dhika’s response
sections.reading: A new call begins after the shower. Bantu discloses his previously withheld observation; Dhika and Bobby learn it here.

sections.title: Further camera interaction
sections.reading: The continuing call includes Dhika’s own camera choices and separate responses from the twins. The narrator marks a change in her outlook; no later outcome is inferred.

sections.title: Unpacking the twins’ gifts
sections.reading: Dhika reflects on the prior call and opens their gifts. This is private aftermath, not a new visit.

sections.title: A planned visit becomes uncertain
sections.reading: A household repair problem makes the planned visit uncertain. Cancellation is communicated later.

sections.title: Calling to cancel the planned visit
sections.reading: Dhika explains the household problem and speaks with both twins. Disappointment and a future request are not a completed visit.

sections.title: Early-morning video call
sections.reading: The twins call while awake early. A challenge, camera choices and requests occur remotely; physical attendance is not implied.

sections.title: A later comparison with Sharmi’s video
sections.reading: Dhika compares a later video with the morning call. This does not repeat the twin call.

sections.title: Reflecting on gifts and changed taste
sections.reading: The twins are recalled in a private reflection about gifts and preferences.

sections.title: Naming the twins in another conversation
sections.reading: Dhika names Bantu and Bobby in a conversation with other characters; their attendance is not established.

sections.title: Imagining company on the couch
sections.reading: Dhika’s hypothetical thought is not recorded as an actual twin encounter.

sections.title: Voice call followed by a video call
sections.reading: Bobby’s voice call leads to discussion about switching to video. Dhika’s later camera choices and the gift being tried are separate stages.

sections.title: Another call and a stay invitation
sections.reading: The twins call again and discuss an upcoming stay and clothing request. John hears the speakerphone exchange; hearing is not initiating the twins’ request.

sections.title: Morning preparation and Bobby call
sections.reading: Preparation for the stay includes a remote conversation with Bobby. Bantu is not automatically included in Bobby’s view.

sections.title: Arrival, greeting and a photo
sections.reading: Dhika arrives at the twins’ home after the rain. Greeting, a request involving Bobby and Bantu’s taking a photo are different actions.

sections.title: Distinct roles before changing
sections.reading: The twins have different roles in this part of the visit. Bobby leaves and Bantu returns the phone; later attendance must follow these transitions.

sections.title: Dinner and the games console
sections.reading: They arrange food, change and settle for games. A message from John belongs to a separate communication channel.

sections.title: Travel plans and game setup
sections.reading: The E59 stay continues through conversation about future plans and learning the console.

sections.title: Learning to play
sections.reading: The everyday game has turns, instructions and different interactions. Winning the game is not permission for later unrelated acts.

sections.title: Bantu-focused interval and withdrawal
sections.reading: The interaction focuses on Bantu and Dhika before she leaves for the bathroom. Her boundary statements must not be flattened into the ongoing action.

sections.title: Bathroom door and a clothing request
sections.reading: After her private reflection Bantu knocks and brings clothes. A request to enter is not proof of entry.

sections.title: Reconsidering a limit and Bobby’s feelings
sections.reading: Dhika reflects privately on a limit and on leaving Bobby out. These thoughts are not knowledge automatically shared with either twin.

sections.title: Private late-night Bobby interval
sections.reading: Bobby has waited while Bantu falls asleep. Dhika approaches him separately; Bantu’s sleeping presence does not make it a group action.

sections.title: Overnight choices and the next morning
sections.reading: Requests about the sleeping arrangement and the next morning form a transition between encounters.

sections.title: Bantu’s bathroom request and private interaction
sections.reading: Bantu asks to enter and the pair interact. The sequence continues in E62; its boundary response must be read there.

sections.title: Boundary statement and interruption
sections.reading: The E61 interaction continues with a stated limit. Bobby’s call from outside interrupts; he is not a participant in the earlier private actions.

sections.title: Breakfast and household conversation
sections.reading: The trio has breakfast and discusses family and construction work. Dhika then takes a separate message.

sections.title: Twins leave for college; lunch delayed
sections.reading: Both explain their college task and leave. Dhika waits and eventually eats alone.

sections.title: Bobby returns and visits Dhika’s room
sections.reading: Bobby enters after the twins return. His initial conversation is distinct from the later group interaction.

sections.title: Bantu joins the private interval
sections.reading: Bantu joins, changing the participant set. The shared sequence has different actor roles and ends unresolved at E62’s boundary.

sections.title: Dhika stops and withdraws
sections.reading: Dhika withdraws from the E62 interaction and communicates a limit. This response belongs to that continued scene.

sections.title: Private Bantu interval
sections.reading: A later private exchange with Bantu follows; Bobby is not included until the later arrival.

sections.title: Bobby joins; shared scene continues
sections.reading: Bobby joins and their roles remain distinct. Ambiguous speech near the end stays uncertain rather than assigning a definite addressee.

sections.title: Bathroom interaction before a retrospective explanation
sections.reading: The opening depicts a current Bantu–Dhika interaction. The narration then moves back a few minutes to explain the preceding request; those two frames are not two independent visits.

sections.title: Recounted aftermath and bathroom request
sections.reading: The account moves back a few minutes within the same stay. A request and promise to enter are reported; the episode later resumes the opening scene.

sections.title: Present-tense reflection and asking for space
sections.reading: Dhika returns to the present frame, asks Bantu to wait outside and reflects on responsibility and her own limit.

sections.title: Journey home and farewell
sections.reading: Because of a punctured bike, the twins drive Dhika home, offer help with luggage and say goodbye.

sections.title: Talking to John afterwards
sections.reading: Dhika discusses the earlier Bantu experience with John. The earlier event is not counted again.

sections.title: Flashback fills an earlier gap
sections.reading: This retrospective account supplies earlier actions omitted from E64. It ends with Bantu leaving and Dhika asking the twins to sleep separately; it is not a new present-day visit.

sections.title: Another flashback: the next morning
sections.reading: The narrated return to the next morning explains a further Bantu interaction while Bobby showers. It is distinct from the later present-day couple conversation.

sections.title: Disclosure and the couple’s response
sections.reading: Dhika speaks to John about the stay and why she returned. The twins are referenced in this conversation rather than present.

sections.title: Party, travel offer and family context
sections.reading: The opening shows the party and a transport offer. The child’s family presence is domestic context, never an adult-action role.

sections.title: Party incident and sleeping arrangements
sections.reading: The party moves to practical help and sleeping-place discussion. Larger-group presence does not establish a selected pair’s action.

sections.title: Recalling the earlier boundary
sections.reading: The narrative recalls the previous day’s Bantu event. Do not count it as occurring at the party.

sections.title: Earlier party preparation: Bantu arrives alone
sections.reading: The narrative goes back to the party preparations. Bobby is away with John, so this arrival is a Bantu-only interval.

sections.title: Private preparation interval, interrupted later
sections.reading: The retrospective Bantu/Dhika interaction continues to the episode boundary; E67 supplies the interruption.

sections.title: John and Bobby return; preparations resume
sections.reading: The E66 retrospective interval is interrupted by John and Bobby arriving. They then prepare the room together with Chotu.

sections.title: Bantu visits while Dhika dresses
sections.reading: Still in the earlier-that-day frame, Bantu enters while Dhika dresses. The no-touching line is an internal thought, not spoken permission or a spoken instruction. She later explicitly says no and sends him out.

sections.title: Larger-group sleeping discussion
sections.reading: John, Chotu and the twins are present for part of the discussion. Separate departures and reactions do not establish a Bobby–Chotu action.

sections.title: Brief visit to the twins’ room
sections.reading: Dhika leaves the other room to check on the twins. Their different observations belong to this brief separate visit.

sections.title: Reporting the unshown room interval
sections.reading: Dhika reports the earlier sweater and tasting sequence, her contact with each twin and a specific Bantu hand redirection. These reports are not a second twin encounter.

sections.title: Morning transport preparation
sections.reading: The twins prepare the car while others arrange luggage and the family leaves.

sections.title: Later private recollections
sections.reading: Dhika recalls earlier twin events during a different scene. These are not new encounters.

sections.title: Bobby’s call and messages
sections.reading: An apparently silent video call is explained by Bobby’s messages. This is remote; Chotu is absent from the call.

sections.title: Travel arrangement and John’s hypothetical question
sections.reading: The narrator explains where the twins have gone. John’s question about what might have happened is hypothetical, not their actual arrival.

sections.title: End-of-episode reflection
sections.reading: The narration refers back to changes over recent months. It is not another meeting.

ambiguities.issue: Conflicting actor name in the shared sequence; original text retained; do not silently resolve.
